run_generate_docs: run the generate script to build html and pdf documentation via make
run_generate_html_only: run the generate script with html as the only extension argument to build html docs
run_generate_pdf_only: run the generate script with pdf as the only extension argument to build pdf docs
review_generate_script: review the generate script that invokes make to build documentation from source files
summarize_generate_script: summarize the generate script which uses syscmd and sources to drive a make-based documentation build
